scope: synthetic hormone-module engineering checks; constants are tagged, mostly [D]/[U]
checks: the hormone state has exactly three fields: stress_x, sleep_pressure, dopamine_tonic
advance(advance(s, t1), t2) == advance(s, t2) for 300 random states and times spanning nights (relative 1e-9)
stress readout stays in [0, 1) and sleep pressure in [0, 1]; pressure strictly rises awake and falls asleep
the awakening rise peaks tau_car (40 min) after waking; the whole baseline peaks at 39 min, inside the verified 30-45 min window; asleep it sits at the floor
repeat increments fade within one or two exposures (habituation reuses the routine exposure count)
same seed, agent, event and purpose give bit-identical results; a different purpose string changes the draw

no agent-type, archetype, role, sex or gender identifier in the module; names, identity facts and tie labels change nothing; across 300 seeded agents the declared inputs explain 0.982 of reactivity and 1.000 of wanting, a nuisance fact adds 1.7e-05
a stubbed household run makes the same number of model calls with and without the module (14)
per-event cost is flat in agent count (21 us at 5 agents, 21 us at 400) and no event, read or wanting call iterates over the agents
tired but wired: high sleep pressure plus high stress gives a longer onset, lower efficiency and more pressure left in the morning than high pressure alone; the flag turns it off
a sleep-deprived listener has lower attention capacity (K 0.53 vs 0.95 rested)

group drift: repeated disappointment sinks a group below a new one with an optimistic prior, a close friend with ~0 prediction error stays most wanted, and leaving becomes possible; an unattended outcome teaches nothing
the style directive is monotone in stress (none, mild, strong), never asks for shorter speech by default, and adds the tired line only under high sleep pressure

each received event records stress at that moment and teaches an expectation of its source; negative mood impulses deepen with stress; the sleep module pays for a stressed bedtime through sleep efficiency
runs standalone with safe defaults (no routine: never asleep; no attention or sleep module); unknown settings are rejected
